limitations: This is a conservative frequency/amplitude screen, not a modal-response or lock-in prediction. It does not include generalized modal force, mode-shape participation, structural damping, turbulence broadening, or aeroelastic feedback. Final evidence comes from the time-domain QBlade baseline/VorLap runs.
method: For each mean wind speed, 1 RPM azimuth, and production VorLap action node, interpolate alternating AmpCF/STCF tones, dimensionalize STCF with the local relative flow and VorLap reference length, and compare each retained tone with the qualified Campbell modes. The force-overlap score is nodal harmonic-force amplitude times a Gaussian detuning kernel. The downtime-weighted score also multiplies by the project 1-percent Rayleigh downtime density.
purpose: Risk-informed preselection of DLC 6.4 mean wind speeds from VorLap/modal overlap.

source_domain_checks.note: The full 1--35 m/s sweep may clip low-Re source queries below the selected matrix; passing requires zero clipping at every selected matrix speed and ranked peak.
